moments.text: Infrared view over grey clouds with a crosshair, corner brackets and black redaction boxes. A small light spot drifts upper right of the crosshair.
The picture breaks into black blocks, almost fully black at 15.1 s, and clears over about 3 s.
The spot drifts far left of the crosshair, about a sixth of the frame from the left edge, then back toward the centre.
The spot swings across to the right, past the right corner brackets, and hangs there before returning to the centre.
Back near the crosshair, the spot often shows as two light blobs, one above the other, with a faint dotted trail below.
A blocky pure-white streak flashes left of centre below the spot while block patterns smear the clouds at lower right; gone by 72 s.
The view zooms in. The blurrier spot drifts to the right edge and slips out of frame around 100 s and 111 s, then returns.
The spot comes back to the crosshair, swings right once more, then settles just right of it as a short vertical chain of blobs.
Zoom out: tall clouds above a low cloud layer, the spot a tiny dot just above the crosshair. Then the picture flashes dark and bright.
Wide, slanting view down onto a vast field of small cloud tops. The scene holds for two minutes with no object.
The sensor whips across in a blur, then pans over broken clouds against darker sky, ending on a field of cloud tops. No object visible.
